cols.label: Cast time
cols.help: The move's timing: wind-up and active frames of each hit.

cols.label: Fixed recovery
cols.help: Frames the legend can't act after the move, whatever happened.

cols.label: Recovery
cols.help: Frames of recovery after the move.

cols.label: Cooldown
cols.help: Frames before this move can be used again.

cols.label: Cooldown on hit
cols.help: Cooldown when the move hit.

cols.label: Stun
cols.help: Frames of hitstun the hit gives (as Training's frame data shows it).

cols.label: Earliest cancel
cols.help: Frames before the move can be cancelled.

cols.label: Gravity cancel time
cols.help: Frames during which a gravity cancel is possible.

cols.label: No-gravity time
cols.help: Frames the legend floats while using it.

cols.label: Minimum charge
cols.help: Frames a charged move charges at least.

cols.label: Damage
cols.help: Damage of each hit (one value, or one per hit with ",").

cols.label: Knockback (grows)
cols.help: Knockback that grows with the target's damage.

cols.label: Knockback (fixed)
cols.help: Knockback that doesn't depend on damage.

cols.label: Minimum knockback
cols.help: The least knockback a hit gives.

cols.label: Knockback direction X
cols.help: Direction of the knockback, sideways part.

cols.label: Knockback direction Y
cols.help: Direction of the knockback, up/down part (negative is up).

cols.label: Most DI
cols.help: How far (degrees) the target can steer the knockback.

cols.label: Hits several times
cols.help: The move can hit the same target more than once.

cols.label: Time between hits
cols.help: For multi-hit moves: frames between two hits.

cols.label: Width
cols.help: Hitbox width per hit ("49&25": a capsule of 49 and 25; "," between hits).

cols.label: Height
cols.help: Hitbox height per hit.

cols.label: Offset X
cols.help: Where the hitbox sits in front of the legend, per hit.

cols.label: Offset Y
cols.help: Where the hitbox sits up/down (negative is up), per hit.

cols.label: Shape
cols.help: How the hitbox is checked (PBAoE: around the legend; others follow the art).

cols.label: Push at start X
cols.help: Speed given when the move starts, sideways.

cols.label: Push at start Y
cols.help: Speed given when the move starts, up/down (negative is up).

cols.label: Push on each hit X
cols.help: Speed given at each active part ("50~5": 50, then 5 per frame).

cols.label: Push on each hit Y
cols.help: Speed given at each active part, up/down.

cols.label: Push when it hits
cols.help: Speed the legend gets when the move hits.

cols.label: No gravity
cols.help: Gravity off during the move.

cols.label: Can steer
cols.help: The legend can move while using it.

cols.label: Speed limit
cols.help: Top speed while using it.

cols.label: Next move
cols.help: The move that follows this one (a combo's next part).

cols.label: Next move if it hit
cols.help: The move that follows when this one hit.

cols.label: Next move on release
cols.help: The move that follows when the button is let go.

cols.label: Next move on a press
cols.help: The move that follows when the button is pressed again.

cols.label: Next move at a wall
cols.help: The move that follows at a wall.

cols.label: Animation
cols.help: The legend's animation for the move.

cols.label: Sound at start
cols.help: The sound played when it starts.

cols.label: Sound on hit
cols.help: The sound played when it hits.
